title: WARNER MUSIC GROUP UNIFIES GLOBAL SYNC OPERATIONS ACROSS RECORDED MUSIC AND PUBLISHING
summary: INDUSTRY VET RON BROITMAN PROMOTED TO PRESIDENT OF GLOBAL SYNC ACROSS WMG. . .
body_markdown:
***INDUSTRY VET RON BROITMAN PROMOTED TO PRESIDENT OF GLOBAL SYNC ACROSS WMG TO LEAD STREAMLINED ORGANIZATION***


[Warner Music Group](http://www.wmg.com/) (NASDAQ: WMG) today announced its plan to strengthen its global sync operations, bringing together its recorded music and publishing divisions to accelerate growth.


The streamlined group will be led by long-time music industry executive Ron Broitman, who has been promoted to President, Global Sync. Based in Los Angeles he will report to Tom Corson, COO of WMG, with additional strategic oversight from Guy Moot, Chair & CEO of Warner Chappell Music (WCM).


Broitman will lead WMG’s sync teams around the world, including embedded team members across WCM, Atlantic Music Group, Warner Records Group and ADA. The division will oversee creative pitching and marketing, new business development, licensing clearance, administration, and data analytics across all WMG sync rights globally.


The new structure gives clients a single point of entry to WMG’s full catalog of recorded music and music publishing, creating a simpler, more efficient licensing experience. Streamlined clearances will accelerate turnaround times, while a combined, globally coordinated approach will expand pitching reach across WMG’s roster.


Corson said: “Ron operates at the highest level and has been a bedrock of our best-in-class sync operation over the years with his steady leadership, extensive network and deep expertise in the field. This change establishes one creative strategy, one commercial business conversation, one clearance and one admin path for all WMG sync rights globally, speeding our path to market, simplifying the client experience and expanding opportunities for our artists, songwriters and the creative community.”


Moot said: “Bringing music publishing and WMG’s recorded business together under one roof is an ambitious growth move that sets us apart from the competition and will unlock even more value for our songwriters. Our WCM team will remain embedded in our sync business to ensure our writers continue to receive the care, focus and creative pitching they deserve.”


Broitman added: “Unifying our teams makes us a stronger partner for our clients. We are making it easier and faster to license our entire global library, which means more and bigger wins for our artists and songwriters. I’m grateful to Tom and Guy for their trust and support, and I’m energized to lead this team into its next chapter.”


Broitman most recently served as EVP, Global Sync for WMG’s recorded music business, leading a team that secured key placements in blockbuster moments from the Super Bowl to the *Stranger Things* finale, recently landing Led Zeppelin’s “Stairway to Heaven” in the trailer for Greta Gerwig’s forthcoming film *Narnia: The Magician’s Nephew* . Prior, he was EVP, Head of Sync for WCM & WMG, overseeing a joint sync operation in the US. Before joining WMG, he served as SVP of Film, TV & Advertising at Sony/ATV Music Publishing, where he built and managed the department responsible for placing and negotiating the company’s entire repertoire across visual media. Earlier, at BMG Music Publishing, he merged and oversaw the joint sync business for all BMG and Zomba Music Publishing catalogs and BMG recorded music labels, including Arista, Jive, and RCA. Broitman holds a B.A. in Economics from UCLA and a J.D. from Cornell Law School.
